title: Pressure at D
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at D using centripetal force and Newton's third law, yielding 25.6 N.

title: Velocity at C
description: Essential: Correctly applies energy conservation between C and D to find v_C = 5 m/s.

title: Energy-work reasoning
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem for the AB segment, relating power, friction work, and kinetic energy at B.

title: Projectile motion analysis
description: Important: Correctly decomposes v_C into components and uses kinematics to find height difference h = 0.45 m and horizontal distance x = 1.2 m.

title: Time of force application
description: Essential: Solves for the time t from the work-energy relation, obtaining t = 0.4 s.

title: Velocity at B
description: Important: Correctly identifies v_B from the horizontal component of v_C, or from energy, as 4 m/s.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units (kg, m, s, N, J, W) throughout the calculation.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Misapplies sign for work done by friction or misidentifies the direction of forces in circular motion.

title: Trigonometric misuse
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses sin/cos for the projectile launch angle or the energy conservation angle term (1-cosα).
